prompt: I'm sorry I didn't revise more for the exam. → I wish …
instruction_ru: Перепишите целое предложение с заданным началом.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлом выражается через wish + Past Perfect.

blanks.answer: I wish I had revised more for the exam.
accepted_answers: I wish I had revised more for the exam.
I wish I'd revised more for the exam.

answer_text: I wish I had revised more for the exam.

prompt: If only my brother were here; he would know how to fix this tap.
instruction_ru: Исправьте ошибку. Верное предложение перепишите без изменений.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: If only + were про настоящее, would know в главной части.
answer: If only my brother were here; he would know how to fix this tap.
accepted_answers: If only my brother were here; he would know how to fix this tap.

prompt: You can park here ___ you leave before eight. Take a sandwich ___ you get hungry on the train. I won't sign the contract ___ I read every page first. I'm going to the match ___ it rains; nothing will stop me.
instruction_ru: Заполните пропуски словами из банка. Два варианта лишние.
explanation_ru: As long as ставит условие, in case означает «на всякий случай», unless значит «если не», even if значит «даже если».
answer_text: You can park here as long as you leave before eight. Take a sandwich in case you get hungry on the train. I won't sign the contract unless I read every page first. I'm going to the match even if it rains; nothing will stop me.

prompt: Of course you can borrow my car for the weekend, ___ you promise to fill the tank before you bring it back.
explanation_ru: Provided (that) задаёт условие «при условии, что»; unless значило бы обратное, in case не условие, whether не подходит по смыслу.

prompt: We will go camping only if the weather is dry. → We won't go camping unless …
instruction_ru: Перепишите целое предложение с заданным началом.
explanation_ru: Unless = if not: главная часть отрицательная, а после unless глагол в утвердительной форме.

blanks.answer: We won't go camping unless the weather is dry.
accepted_answers: We won't go camping unless the weather is dry.
We will not go camping unless the weather is dry.

answer_text: We won't go camping unless the weather is dry.

prompt: Take your card with you in case you will need to pay for the tickets.
instruction_ru: Исправьте ошибку. Верное предложение перепишите без изменений.
explanation_ru: После in case будущее не ставится: нужно Present Simple (you need).
answer: Take your card with you in case you need to pay for the tickets.
accepted_answers: Take your card with you in case you need to pay for the tickets.
